# idempotent repository registration

The system exposes an idempotent repository registration behavior: registering the same slug multiple times returns the same repository id. This prevents duplicate repository records and allows callers to safely call registration during initialization.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage.test_init_is_idempotent`
